section_disposition.reason: Basic attacks are taught with Whisper's ammunition and critical-strike pattern.
Primary passive card covers ammunition, final-round damage and critical-strike rewards.
Primary Q card covers bounce targeting and damage growth after deaths.

summary: One overview and five primary ability cards teach Jhin's ammunition rhythm, grenade bounces, conditional root, traps and long-range ultimate. Related passive effects and recast shots remain merged with their parent abilities.
